rows.prompt: Bust-to-waist, three-quarter portrait of a heavyset, middle-aged police desk sergeant standing behind the front desk of a Victorian station house, sleeves rolled to the elbow over a gunmetal-blue wool tunic with brass buttons and sergeant's stripes on the upper sleeve, no helmet, one thumb keeping his place in a thick ledger, an enamel tea mug steaming at his elbow, the unflappable, faintly weary air of a man who has found every lost umbrella in London. Warm gaslight-amber key light from a desk lamp on one side, cool gunmetal-blue dominant in the uniform and ambient fill, real cast shadows. Confident inked contours softened under paint, faint paper-grain texture, directional gaslight. Background a soft blur of a wall of pigeonholes and a lost-property cupboard, a single boot and a bowler hat on its top shelf.
extraNegatives: no legible lettering on the ledger, tags or cupboard
rows.notes: PT-37. Constable Mudd's deck filler (src/cards/data/decks/mudd.ts), Yard, common, 1 pt: "Minds the front desk, the lost-property cupboard, and the tea." Attach the taproom reference and portrait-constable-tobias-mudd.webp (the Yard reference, as for beat-partner and night-constable). Do not attach sergeant-pike: the two sergeants should stay distinct (Pike is outdoors with folded arms; this one is indoors at a desk). After Gemini: save the download as art/inbox/desk-sergeant.jpeg (png, jpg or webp also work), run npm run ingest-art -- art/prompts/sheet-8-manifest.json, and expect public/art/desk-sergeant.webp at 600x800. Then do the after-ingest steps in docs/logs/2026-10-14.md.
